core_problem_solved: To provide a simple library for serializing Java objects to XML and back again, without requiring modifications to the objects (like mappings or annotations).
key_features: Reflection-based serialization of arbitrary Plain Old Java Objects (POJOs)
Ability to deserialize XML back into complete object graphs
A focus on ease of use with a zero-configuration approach
era_and_niche: A popular XML serialization library in the mid-to-late 2000s, praised for its simplicity and ability to serialize almost any object without prior mapping.
reason_for_obsolescence: This is a **legacy library and its use is strongly discouraged**. It has a well-documented history of **critical security vulnerabilities** related to arbitrary code execution during deserialization from untrusted XML. The modern, safer, and standard approaches for Java-to-XML data binding are **JAXB** (the Jakarta XML Binding standard) or the **Jackson XML extension** (`com.fasterxml.jackson.dataformat:jackson-dataformat-xml`).
